tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: exam_schedule_lookup
tools.description: When is this Japanese national exam held and when are results announced, as published on MHLW's list page, and did the dates change? Give exam (exam_id like nurse, or the name in Japanese or English); omit it to list exams, optionally by category. Returns next_events and all events with ISO dates, r

tools.name: exam_schedule_changes
tools.description: Which exam dates on MHLW's list page of national qualification exams changed, appeared or left the list since a date (this service's own record of page versions; MHLW keeps none)? Each change has before and after as published and the time this service first read it. Optional exam and change_type fil

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "exam_schedule_changes" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Which exam dates on MHLW's list page of national qualification exams changed, appeared or left the list since a date (this service's own record of page versions…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
